name: spaces_delete_connection
description: Deletes workflow connections. Pass `connectionIds` with up to 20 ids to delete a batch in one call, or `connectionId` for a single one — never both. An already-absent id is an idempotent no-op. @see guides_get('spaces')

connectionId.description: A single connection. Mutually exclusive with connectionIds.

connectionIds.description: Delete several connections in one call. Mutually exclusive with connectionId.

pageId.description: Both endpoints must belong to this page.
